lyrics.text: Paper wings and a borrowed sky
We were too young to ask it why
Every road was a runway then
Every ending was a start again
So hold the string, don't let it go
The wind is ours, and it won't let go
Fly, little wren, over the sea
Higher than all that we're meant to be
Sing it out loud till the morning comes
We are the light, we are the young
Summer burned like a reel of film
We wrote our names where the tide stood still
Tell me nothing will ever change
Tell me again, and again, and again
So hold the string, don't let it go
The wind is ours, and it won't let go
Fly, little wren, over the sea
Higher than all that we're meant to be
Sing it out loud till the morning comes
We are the light, we are the young
And if the wind should fall
And if the string should break
I'll still be flying
I'll still be flying

Higher than all that we're meant to be
Sing it out loud till the morning comes
